final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) as total_races FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.circuitId, step1.race_count, CAST(step1.race_count AS REAL) / step2.total_races as proportion FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3) SELECT step3.circuitId, step3.race_count, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as difference FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
